symptom: A pluggable widget's attribute property given a context-relative association path — `switch sw (Attribute: Order_Owner/Active)` — passed check, exec reported "Created page", and mxbuild 11.16.0 answered CE1613 "The selected attribute 'MyFirstModule.Order.Order_Owner/Active' no longer exists". A built-in input with the same path was fine.
cause: The engine's Attribute mapping (and the schema-key pass) resolved the value with resolveAttributePathForEntity, which knows plain names only, so the whole path was qualified with the context entity as one flat attribute name. The built-in inputs, Data grid 2 columns and params go through the association-aware resolveAssociationPathFrom; the `$Root/Assoc/Attr` form on the same property already did (#2107). check's MDL-ATTRPATH01/02 judge qualified paths only, so the short form was never looked at.
fix: A context-relative path is resolved with resolveAssociationPathFrom into the final attribute plus EntityRefSteps (SetAttributeWithSteps: AttributeRef + IndirectEntityRef, Studio Pro's shape). A property linked to no datasource additionally refuses a reference-set hop and a reference followed from its non-owner end (owner Both passes); an unresolved path is refused instead of written flat. check calls the same function, skipping paths that name what the script creates.
insight: The task framing assumed the widget's IsPath/PathType decide which properties take paths. They do not: those are legacy custom-widget fields, "No"/"None" on all 604 template properties AND on PedApp's Studio Pro-authored DG2 column that stores a reference-set path. Pluggable widget XML has no path declaration; what decides is the property's datasource link, and the hop rule was settled by mx check, not by reading: refset CE7247 'should be of type Reference', backwards reference CE7247 'has no association', owner Both reverse 0 errors. Reference shape found by scanning testdata/pedapp mprcontents for a CustomWidgets$WidgetValue whose AttributeRef has an EntityRef (Administration.Account_Overview).
test: mdl/executor/pluggable_association_path_2279_test.go (stored steps on PedApp; refusals in exec and check; controls: plain attribute, built-in textbox with the same path, forward reference passes check)
